description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/agent/stream_events.ex and new test/zaq/agent/attachment_selection_test.exs plus additive stream_events tests. StreamEvents owns selected Record state for one accepted request, initialized empty, and uses AttachDocuments.reduce_selection only after scoped output expansion and schema/provenance validation. Correlate the actual resolved Action/native invocation to the current request; tool name text or an arbitrary nested child completion must not select by itself. Support current native envelopes, including ToolResult, without bypassing output validation.
Apply concurrent tool instructions in native declaration order, not completion order. Reuse the existing canonical invocation collection/order and replay/terminal guards; no parallel invocation database, process mailbox or ServerManager selection cache. Duplicate completions apply once. Successful calls update selection; failed/malformed/foreign/unknown calls preserve prior valid state and remain tool feedback/safe private trace evidence. Partial failures across calls and later successful retries never create outgoing error flags.
Tests to add before implementation: real streamed tool iterations and generated ordered instruction sequences; conflicting concurrent add/remove/replace declared out of completion order; duplicated/replayed completion, completion-only/unknown identity, nested unrelated action, wrong request and late terminal events. Same-request steering can change selection; other/new requests cannot. Cancellation, provider failure after selection, worker exit, handoff and suppressed partial failures discard files while preserving existing answer/tool trace semantics. Test error then successful retry, success then failure then later success, malformed output and unknown aliases without poisoning prior selection. Trace/public evidence never leaks bytes/handles/capabilities.
Branches/paths validated: successful terminal with selection, empty clear, ordinary no-tool run, retained native traces and public steps, error/cancel/unknown terminal, server reuse, concurrent request attempts, duplicate declaration/replay and mixed envelopes. No files are published on intermediate updates or failed/suppressed results.
Mocking plan: use real Jido native runner/Factory and existing ToolCallingLLMStub only at LLM HTTP boundary. Synchronize concurrency with monitored processes/messages; avoid sleeps, global config, internal reducer stubs or hand-built evidence that bypasses runtime correlation.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: StreamEvents result/ownership docs and docs/services/agent.md lifecycle, order, feedback and terminal cleanup contracts.
Action reuse assessment: extend StreamEvents request reducer; reuse AttachDocuments Action/pure reducer and OpaqueAliases output expansion, current invocation evidence/terminal semantics. No new Action or lifecycle service. Inputs are trusted current-request native events; output is final canonical selected Records only on success plus unchanged evidence. No provider acquisition/delivery, persistence or automatic retries. Verify real runtime uses the same selection implementation and cross-request state cannot leak.

Approved integration point: preserve StreamEvents.handle_tool_completed/2 -> complete_tool_call/5 and its existing correlation/replay checks. Reduce validated selection before trace evidence conversion; never reconstruct delivery records from tool_calls[].response. No second tool-call collector.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.

comments.text: Implemented request-local selection within existing StreamEvents.handle_tool_completed -> complete_tool_call, its tool_calls collection, invocation sequence and hierarchy/replay checks. Validated canonical instructions remain private on the existing invocation rows before trace conversion; result folds them by existing native declaration sequence and strips private data from exported evidence. Matching native root starts/request IDs are required; failed/malformed completions leave prior selection unchanged. Output alias expansion reuses OpaqueAliases; AttachDocuments.validate_output and reduce_selection are authoritative. Native-handle consumers ignore foreign request events; legacy stream behavior remains covered by unchanged tests. Success-only final attachments; error/cancel/handoff/max-iteration/exhaustion discard them. Existing evidence/status helpers redact selection capabilities. New tests cover reverse completion order, replay, unknown/nested/foreign/late calls, malformed output, failed-outcome envelopes, retry, clear and cross-scope aliases. Final mix q and all 502 focused checks passed. No parallel collector/process/cache or delivery state.

title: [zaq-pi3.5] Reduce attachment selection within the native request lifecycle
